name: SRIDGE
recent: Silver Ridge Holdings 近期推进私募配售，发行价定为每股 RM0.105，并已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多 43,943,082 股配售股份。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 11 日召开第 21 届年度股东大会，同时有多项董事及大股东权益变动公告。最新财报显示 2026 财年营收同比增长 162.9%，但净亏损为 RM1,353,000。
notable: 发行价固定为每股 RM0.105，较 5 日加权平均市价折价约 5.83%。
Bursa Securities 批准最多 43,943,082 股私募配售股份在 ACE Market 上市。
risks: 私募配售涉及发行最多 43,943,082 股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事在闭门期内有交易意向，包括 MR TAN KOK CHIN 和 MR VINCENT GAN KEAN CHEANG。
最新季度净亏损扩大，净利率由正转负。
earnings: 2026 财年营收为 RM15,175,000，同比增长 162.9%，但环比下降 25.4%；净亏损为 RM1,353,000，净利率 -8.9%，而上一期净利率为 2.5%。

recent_en: Silver Ridge Holdings is proceeding with a private placement priced at RM0.105 per share, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 43,943,082 placement shares. The latest financial results show FY2026 revenue up 162.9% year-on-year, but a net loss of RM1,353,000.
notable_en: Proposed private placement: issue price fixed at RM0.105 per share, a discount of about 5.83% to the 5-day VWAP.
Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 43,943,082 placement shares on the ACE Market.
Proposed change of company name to Tangerine Holdings Bhd.
risks_en: The private placement involves issuing up to 43,943,082 new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors indicated intentions to deal during the closed period, including MR TAN KOK CHIN and MR VINCENT GAN KEAN CHEANG.
The latest quarter saw a wider net loss, with net margin turning negative.
earnings_en: FY2026 revenue was RM15,175,000, up 162.9% year-on-year but down 25.4% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM1,353,000 with a net margin of -8.9%, compared to a net margin of 2.5% in the prior period.
